item.description:
• The menu bar panel has a Library card: what you've saved, an Open button (⌘L) and the five Create tools, one click from the panel.
  • A new Home in the Library: pick a color, start a mood board, a design system or a palette, and reopen your latest palettes, all from one page.
  • The Library takes its look from colorpickr.app: each tool has its own color in the sidebar, and the Home and Pro pages use the website's type and color strip. Boards, palettes and the Color Wheel stay neutral, so your colors look true.
  • A shorter sidebar: five main tools under Create, the rest under More Tools, and Mood Boards, Palettes and Themes fold away.
  • The Library opens larger, remembers its size and position, and goes full screen from the green button.

• Quick Pick (⌃⌥C) now uses the macOS magnifier: your screen stays live, click picks, Esc cancels. It needs no Screen Recording permission, so picking works the moment you install ColorPickr. A small card by the cursor shows what you picked, its name in plain words and the format it was copied in.
  • Precision Pick (⌃⌥⇧C) is the frozen-screen picker, for 3×3 and 5×5 averages, pixel nudging and dragging an area into a palette.
  • Screen Recording permission is now optional. It powers Precision Pick, Screen Check and the color vision simulation.

• Fixed: the picker could seem frozen when macOS kept another app in front. Your first click now picks right away, and Esc always closes the picker.
  • macOS's own Screen Recording prompt and ColorPickr's alert no longer appear at the same time.
